C01.name: Iran‑Israel/US War / Hormuz
C01.narrative: A multi‑theater conflict involving Iran, Israel, and the United States, centred on the Strait of Hormuz and regional proxy forces.

timeline.2026‑02‑20: Initial escalation: Iran threatens to close Hormuz.
timeline.2026‑04‑13: US imposes naval blockade of Iranian ports.
timeline.2026‑06‑09: US retaliation within 72 hours following IRGC attack.

C01.current_status: Active conflict with ongoing missile exchanges and naval skirmishes. SCP: 0.95.
C01.forecast: Likely escalation to full‑scale war within 14 days. Probability: 95%.
recommendations: Pre‑position humanitarian supplies in the region.
Advise shipping to avoid Gulf waters.
Prepare for mass casualty events in Haifa, Tel Aviv, Tehran.

C03.name: Horn of Africa Famine
C03.narrative: A catastrophic food crisis affecting Somalia, Kenya, Ethiopia, and South Sudan, driven by drought, conflict, and oil price shocks.

timeline.2026‑05‑01: IPC Phase 5 declared in parts of Somalia.
timeline.2026‑06‑01: Famine expands to Kenya and Ethiopia.

C03.current_status: Famine conditions are worsening. 19.5M acutely food insecure.
C03.forecast: Famine will expand to additional regions within 30 days. Probability: 85%.
recommendations: Pre‑position food and water in the Horn.
Use local logistics networks for distribution.
